prompt_fragment: This asset is a top-down hex tile. Compose it for clear map readability, with the terrain filling the frame evenly and no horizon line.
raw_description:
A uniform SATURATED RUBY-CRIMSON flat color field — think #B04646,
the color of inherited ritual, ancestry, and remembered obligation on
a semantic map. The hue must read unmistakably as RED, not brown, not
tan, not muted rose. Clearly distinct from the warm-tan wastes tile and
from the orange severance tile. Fill the ENTIRE 1024x1024 square edge-to-
edge with this one ruby-crimson color corner to corner — NO drawn hex,
NO paper border, NO vignette, NO centered composition, NO symbols, NO
figures, NO roots, NO script. Only the faintest paint-texture variation
within the same red hue. A semantic terrain region-fill swatch, not an
illustration.

formatted_prompt.scene: Vibrant comic-map terrain tile rendered in confident saturated ink wash, pure ruby-crimson field filling the entire square edge-to-edge, faint paint-texture variation within the same bold red hue, no figures or symbols.

subjects.description: Flat saturated ruby-crimson wash covering every pixel corner to corner, subtle brushstroke texture variation within the same red tone, uniform game-tile terrain fill.
